adult_dose: PO/PR: 325–1000 mg q4–6h; max 4 g/day (3 g/day in chronic alcohol use or hepatic impairment). IV: 1 g q6h.
pediatric_dose: 10–15 mg/kg PO q4–6h, max 75 mg/kg/day (not to exceed adult max).
hepatic_adjustment: Reduce max to 2–3 g/day in chronic liver disease; avoid in acute hepatic failure.
max_dose: Adult: 4 g/day (2–3 g/day in at-risk populations).
indications: Component of multimodal analgesia to spare opioids
key_monitoring: Total daily dose (all routes combined — easy to exceed with PRN + scheduled + combo products)
LFTs in prolonged administration or at-risk patients
Patient history for concurrent acetaminophen-containing products (e.g., Percocet, Norco, cold remedies)
lasa_pairs: amoxicillin (shared shelf position in some pyxis layouts)
